title: The Verdict – How films are judged, awarded and remembered
summary: Not how a film is made, but how it is seen, valued, selected and awarded. Led by a Golden Globes voter and European Film Academy member, this workshop looks at what voters look for, how critical consensus forms, and how a film travels from festival to prize.
forWho: Film lovers, aspiring critics and anyone curious about how films are valued and rewarded.
levelNote: Open to everyone. No background in film criticism needed.

explore.title: How films are judged
explore.text: What voters look for, how critical consensus forms, and how a film travels from festival to prize.

explore.title: Watching together
explore.text: A film watched as a group, with attention to what to notice while watching.

explore.title: Writing a review
explore.text: Analysis, evaluation and narration: how a review is built. Task: write a review.

explore.title: The shadow side: censorship
explore.text: Concrete, comparative cases from specific countries: what was cut or banned, and who decided.

outcome: You’ll leave knowing how films are evaluated from the inside, and with a finished review of your own.
